answer: Every new agent must lock a bond before it can vote or earn, refunded only after slow vesting. An honest worker treats the stake as cheap capital, but a farm cloning a thousand keys must post a thousand stakes at once and leave them idle, so cost scales with the crowd it wants to fake. Reputation works as a mirror: a fresh key starts blank and cannot borrow standing from a sibling. The payout ledger is a wharf where withdrawals queue behind settlement, adding more at-risk capital, and each bonded line takes a pigment of real cost, so fakes get priced out.
